name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 2; Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 – Article 8a – § 5 – point b – 173
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 261/2004, (EC) No 1107/2006, (EU) No 1177/2010, (EU) No 181/2011 and (EU) 2021/782 as regards enforcement of passenger rights in the Union
part_text: (b) if the passenger does not receive the reimbursement within 14 days as of the date of choosing a reimbursement in accordance with Article 8(1), point (a), first indent, the operating air carrier shall reimburse the passenger directly, using the original payment method where technically possible, without requiring the passenger to submit a new reimbursement request. Where the necessary payment details are unavailable, the operating air carrier shall contact the passenger at the latest on the day following the expiry of the 14-day period in order to obtain them.
